top_actors.justification: This Forum is the central subject of the document, being the main platform for dialogue and decision-making on sustainable development in Latin America and the Caribbean. top_actors.name: Community of Latin American and Caribbean States
top_actors.justification: The Community of Latin American and Caribbean States is an important regional political actor that influences and supports multilateral cooperation in the region. While less prominently mentioned than the Forum, it holds significant influence in regional integration and sustainable development efforts.
